body.en: Lattice's icon is now olive on cream.
body.zh: Lattice 的图标换成了奶油底色上的橄榄绿。

body.en: The website now has a live demo of the real Lattice workspace at https://leo1oel.github.io/lattice/demo/, so you can try it before you download.
body.zh: 网站上新增了真实 Lattice 工作区的在线演示（https://leo1oel.github.io/lattice/demo/），下载前即可先试用。
